description: an error thrown by a nextTick callback is an uncaughtException; the other ticks of its batch and the timers still run (the timer is 100 ms off: Node runs the rest of the batch at its next tick drain, which a 5 ms timer can beat on a slow host)
argv: process.on('uncaughtException', (e) => console.log('caught', e.message)); process.nextTick(() => { throw new Error('t1'); }); process.nextTick(() => console.log('t2 still runs')); setTimeout(() => console.log('timer'), 100)
